description: This file implements the IUnknown interface handling, including stub and proxy classes for remote procedure calls, reference counting, and interface querying within the Thunder namespace.

classes.name: UnknownStub
classes.description: Stub class handling incoming IPC messages for IUnknown interface, managing reference counting and interface querying.

classes.name: UnknownProxy
classes.description: Proxy class for invoking remote IUnknown methods over IPC, managing connection and shutdown procedures.

methods.name: UnknownStub::Handle
methods.description: Handles incoming IPC messages based on method index, performing AddRef, Release, or QueryInterface operations.

methods.name: UnknownProxy::Invoke
methods.description: Invokes a remote method via IPC channel, handling timeouts and errors.

methods.name: UnknownProxy::Id
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the IPC channel.

methods.name: UnknownProxy::Shutdown
methods.description: Closes the IPC channel to prevent side effects after a timeout or error.
